referenceFunction.generalComment: Calculation for transport distances assuming transport by pipeline offshore and onshore as well as sea transport in tanker. Sites and modes of transportation based on the supply situation in 2023. UUID=bbfbeaef-9916-3199-9b90-23a534adb098
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: Transportation of crude oil from exploration sites to refineries in PE-region. Includes transport service requirements and emissions from oil handling and evaporation.

representativeness.samplingProcedure: Literature. Online calculators for distances. The consumption mix is calculated based on international trade statistics for 2023.
